name: Underwater Exploration, Breath & Aquatic Environment Runtime
design_rules: breath drains only while the head is submerged
surfacing restores breath quickly without a loading transition
deeper water reduces visibility and available light
turbid water reduces visibility before it changes color identity
underwater current continues to influence character motion
exhausted breath first reduces control and stamina before any lethal policy
underwater exploration supports ruins, caves and aquatic ecology as future content
underwater rendering never uses emissive or glow feedback
